verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs say remixing creates an independent, freely editable copy of a project on any plan, so a founder can start from an existing project instead of a blank prompt. A hands-on community report confirms that a user signed up and picked a template to start from. Documentation is thin, though: one line on remixing and no first-party description of a template gallery. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing a template library or community project gallery, how to discover and browse community projects to remix, and detail on template or remix scope.
